DEPICTS A FULLY EXPOSED LOW LEVEL CIRCULATION CENTER (LLCC), POSITIOEND 
TO THE NORTH OF A AN AREA OF PERSISTENT DEEP CONVECTION, SHEARED TO THE

ENVIRONMENTAL ANALYSIS REVEALS A MARGINAL ENVIRONMENT FOR DEVELOPMENT

STRONG POLEWARD UPPER-LEVEL OUTFLOW, AND WARM SEA SURFACE TEMPERATURES

DEFINED CIRCUCLATION HOWEVER, THE SYSTEM STRUGGLES TO MEET WIND SPEED
